sections.title: Brand Edit
sections.caption: Shot and edited a promotional reel showcasing the new store of Kaveri Jewellers. Captured the store's interiors, ambience, jewellery displays, and overall aesthetic through carefully planned shots and cinematic camera movements. Edited the footage with engaging transitions, music, and sound design to create an attractive visual presentation that highlights the store's elegance and brand identity.

sections.title: Shortfilm
sections.caption: Edited a short film built entirely from still photographs, carefully sequencing and timing each image to create the illusion of motion and establish a distinct visual style. Designed and incorporated the complete soundscape from scratch, including sound effects, ambience, and background audio, to bring life, depth, and emotion to otherwise silent visuals.
